'''Emitter nozzles''', also known as '''Emitter Tips''', were components used in [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] weaponry. Located at the end of the weapon's [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]], emitter nozzles came in variety of designs. [[Blaster pistol/Legends|Blaster pistols]], [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]], [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster pistols]], and [[Sporting blaster/Legends|sporting blaster]]s all utilized the emitter nozzle. In sporting blasters, such as the [[Defender sporting blaster pistol/Legends|Defender sporting blaster pistol]], a [[galven ring]] was present in the nozzle to help the weapon's blaster bolt to maintain cohesion during the firing process.<ref name="EGWT" /> The emitter nozzles on a [[Remote/Legends|remote]], such as the [[Marksman-H combat remote]], could be configured to release [[Stun/Legends|stun]] blasts, compressed air, non-lethal [[Gas/Legends|gases]], light beams, and loud audio attacks.<ref name="NEGWT">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
